tool_schemas.name: analyze_image
tool_schemas.description: Uploads a base64-encoded image and creates/executes an image-analysis job using the specified vision model (defaulting to gpt-4o-mini when provided), returning the stored request metadata together with the model’s analysis output. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when image_base64 is missing/empty, not valid base64, or mime_type/model are invalid or unsupported; raises AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller is not permitted to submit analysis jobs; and raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when operational limits for image analyses are reached. Raises INTERNAL_ERROR if the image cannot be decoded/ingested or the model invocation fails after the request is accepted.

image_base64.description: Base64-encoded image bytes to upload and analyze.

mime_type.description: MIME type of the provided image (e.g., image/png, image/jpeg).

model.description: Vision model to use for analysis.

request_context.description: Arbitrary JSON context/instructions to store with the analysis request.

tool_schemas.name: analyze_image_from_path
tool_schemas.description: Loads an image from a server-local filesystem path, creates/executes an image-analysis job using the specified vision model, and returns the stored request metadata along with the model’s analysis output. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when local_path is missing/empty or the model is invalid/unsupported; raises NOT_FOUND when the path does not exist; raises FORBIDDEN when the server is not allowed to access the specified path (e.g., outside permitted directories) or the caller is not permitted to submit path-based analyses; and raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when operational limits for image analyses are reached. Raises CONFLICT when the path resolves to a non-file or an unreadable/unsupported image format, and INTERNAL_ERROR if decoding/ingestion or the model invocation fails after the request is accepted.

local_path.description: Server-local filesystem path to the image file to load and analyze.

model.description: Vision model to use for analysis.

request_context.description: Arbitrary JSON context/instructions to store with the analysis request.

tool_schemas.name: list_analysis_jobs
tool_schemas.description: Lists stored image-analysis jobs visible to the caller, newest first. Supports filtering by status, model, tool_name, api_key_id, and time range. Refuses with AUTHORIZATION_ERROR when the API key is missing/invalid or revoked.

api_key.description: Caller API key presented for authentication/authorization.

tool_name.description: Filter by the tool/workflow that created the job.

api_key_id.description: Filter by owning API key id (only allowed when the caller is that key).

created_after.description: Include only jobs created at or after this time (RFC 3339).

created_before.description: Include only jobs created at or before this time (RFC 3339).

page_size.description: Maximum number of jobs to return.

page_token.description: Opaque cursor token from a previous response for pagination.

tool_schemas.name: get_analysis_job
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single analysis job by id, including stored request metadata and any outputs/error details. Refuses with NOT_FOUND if the job does not exist or is not visible to the caller; refuses with AUTHORIZATION_ERROR when the API key is missing/invalid or revoked.

api_key.description: Caller API key presented for authentication/authorization.

tool_schemas.name: cancel_analysis_job
tool_schemas.description: Requests cancellation of an analysis job. If the job is queued or running, transitions it to cancelled and records finished_at; if already terminal (succeeded/failed/cancelled), returns the job unchanged. Refuses with NOT_FOUND if the job does not exist/is not visible; refuses with CONFLICT when the job cannot be cancelled due to an in-progress state transition; refuses with AUTHORIZATION_ERROR when the API key is missing/invalid or revoked.

api_key.description: Caller API key presented for authentication/authorization.

reason.description: Optional human-readable cancellation reason to store for auditing/debugging.

tool_schemas.name: list_images
tool_schemas.description: Lists stored images ingested for analysis visible to the caller, newest first. Supports filtering by source_type and sha256. Refuses with AUTHORIZATION_ERROR when the API key is missing/invalid or revoked.

api_key.description: Caller API key presented for authentication/authorization.

source_type.description: Filter by how the image was ingested.

created_after.description: Include only images created at or after this time (RFC 3339).

created_before.description: Include only images created at or before this time (RFC 3339).

page_size.description: Maximum number of images to return.

page_token.description: Opaque cursor token from a previous response for pagination.

tool_schemas.name: get_image
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single stored image record by id (metadata only, such as storage_url, sha256, dimensions). Refuses with NOT_FOUND if the image does not exist or is not visible to the caller; refuses with AUTHORIZATION_ERROR when the API key is missing/invalid or revoked.

api_key.description: Caller API key presented for authentication/authorization.

tool_schemas.name: get_current_identity
tool_schemas.description: Returns the calling identity derived from the presented API key, including its status, granted limits, and current usage/rate-limit snapshot for the active day. Refuses with AUTHORIZATION_ERROR when the API key is missing/invalid or revoked.

api_key.description: Caller API key presented for authentication/authorization.

usage_date.description: Optional date bucket (YYYY-MM-DD) for which to return usage; defaults to server-local current date.
